note: Private family campground/RV park beside Gehrke's Lake in rural Hardin County, with nightly/weekend RV sites and permanent seasonal spots. Paddle boats on the lake, walking and ATV trails. --Claude
summary: Season, dump, WiFi, request-form booking confirmed; no rate on any operator page; Hipcamp listing is unclaimed, so 'bookable on Hipcamp' removed. CRITERIA flag: long-stay character with no posted nightly rate.
flags: CRITERIA (private gate): RATE: none dated 2024+ from operator or engine. Own site posts no price; the book-now page is a plain form; Hipcamp says 'Coming soon to Hipcamp. Contact this campground for pricing and availability', '1 site', 'Verify your listing' (unclaimed, no price, so no host/inclusive figures exist). A Google review I read says 'camper hookups and tent camping at $20 a night', with an owner reply 'Tent camping is $10 a night' (date not captured). RV Life avg_rate $30. $50 gate: nothing suggests over it; no gateway within 40 km (nearest St. Paul 284 km), none needed. PRESENCE: pass, working site + phone 641-750-8907, Google open 4.8 with 39 reviews, phone matches. RV LIFE: $$ (price_level 2).

CRITERIA (long-stay tests): seasonal share has no count. Evidence: About page 'We also provide permanent spots for seasonal campers who wish to leave their campers here'; Google reviews 'areas for both permanent and weekend visitor sites', 'The main part of the campground was pretty packed bc it's Labor Day weekend', 'Short term campsites are mostly lakeside'. Esri imagery (undated, leafless trees) at the pin shows about 60 rigs parked tight in rows east of the office, which reads like seasonals, plus about 10 near the lake. Test 1 (<= $50): pass on the reports. Test 2 (nights really for sale): operator states 'weekend camping' and takes reservations by form, but posts NO nightly rate, and an RV Life tier does not stand in here: FAILS if this counts as long-stay in character. Test 3 (no minimum over 2): none stated, pass. Test 4 (1 in 10 nightly): no count, pass. Test 5 (home community): no homes for sale, pass. My read: probably mostly seasonal in the main block, with a real transient side by the lake; on the fence. AWH's 2026-10-31 rule (on the fence + mostly seasonal + iffy = drop and report) points to a DROP candidate unless a phone call or a dated rate changes it. Reviews also mention a poor bathroom (owner reply says remodeled) and one complaint about a promised full-hookup site I read only in part.

RATINGS: Google 4.8 (39). RV Life: rating_count 6 and star_rating 4 in the page JSON against stored stars 5; I did not read the review text there, and a search digest (not read directly) said 10.0 from 3 reviews and a $30 stay in April 2022. Campendium and The Dyrt: no listing found. Campspot: none. No rating under 4.

WATERFRONT LEAD: lakeview is borderline in both directions. Most rigs (the east rows, 42.4060,-93.3135 to -93.3120) are 150-280 m from the lake with trees and buildings between, and would be not waterfront. About 10 rigs at the NW end (around 42.4070,-93.3160) are about 30-50 m from the lake, but a track runs along the shore between. A reviewer says 'Short term campsites are mostly lakeside', and the operator 'on the shores of Gehrke's Lake' is marketing. No site map exists to place them. Holds as lakeview on the NW end on what I can see; on-water would need photos of a pad at the shore. Pin at the office/rows: fine. Google's own pin (42.4040,-93.3118) is about 300 m SE, on the road.

Hookups unset: no operator page states them; a review mentions asking for full hook-ups. The services page's 'cozy camping store' reads as template text; camp_store not written. Stored 'seasonals may store campers over winter' is not stated on the pages I read (the site says 'leave their campers here'), dropped.
